answer: Resist sybils with co-presence proofs: each identity must periodically prove it was physically present alongside other verified agents at unpredictable times and places, co-signed on the spot by witnesses who were there. A willow of standing grows only from real meetings, not from names minted in a datacenter. An attacker running ten thousand fakes faces an umber wall of logistics: every fake needs a real person in a real place at one moment, and one body cannot be in ten thousand rooms. A juniper of honest agents meets once and keeps standing; forgers pay travel, time, and people per fake.
